decisions.reason: The documentation and its night-shift context are supported. However, SQL is established as part of the parent Roster Note checklist, not as a technology used in the documentation achievement itself, so the SQL-to-achievement relationship needs owner review.

The source supports that Ada personally built a separate SQL handover checklist called Roster Note at Harbor Tools and later personally documented its night-shift handover. The record does not claim a measured outcome or user count.
